newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea Savoy Hotel ups New Star stake.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea Savoy Hotel ups New Star stake.

text.p: South Korea's Savoy Hotel raised its stake in New Star Trading Co to 24.7 percent from 13.59 percent by buying 11.11 percent of New Star's outstanding shares in the open market, the Korea Stock Exchange said on Wednesday.
The statement said Savoy bought 53,070 New Star shares on April 9 and 10 for 4.19 billion won.
Savoy's increased stake outpaced the combined 23.17 percent stake held by the family of New Star's chairman, the current owner of the company, the statement said.
It was not clear from the statement whether Savoy's purchase of the additional shares was a simple equity investment or aimed at taking over the garment maker.
Savoy officials were not immediately available for comment.
